'''Uroš Desnica''' (25 July 1944 – 17 November 2021) was a Croatian physicist. In 1968, he graduated experimental physics from the [[Faculty of Science, University of Zagreb]] and started to work at the [[Ruđer Bošković Institute]] in the materials research and electronics department. He received his doctoral degree from the Zagreb University in 1978 for his research of the physics of [[semiconductor]]s. In late 1980s, Desnica was a visiting scientist at the [[State University of New York]] and the Scientific Center of the [[Cabot Corporation]] in [[Boston]].{{sfn|Kutleša|1993}}{{sfn|Burčul|2021}}
